script_package.title: 🤯 Your Body's WILD Secrets! #MindBlown
script_package.description: Did you know your brain can power a light bulb? Or that you're taller in the morning? Uncover these mind-blowing human body facts that will leave you speechless! 👇
script_package.spoken_script: Ever wonder what crazy secrets your body hides? Get ready to be amazed! First up, your brain? It generates enough electricity to power a small light bulb! Seriously! Next, ever feel a little shorter at night? You actually are! You're taller in the morning because your spine compresses throughout the day. And finally, your stomach literally replaces its entire lining every few days! Why? To avoid digesting itself! Wild, right?
